title: Group Fitness Class Passes: waitlist availability, standby access and studio capacity priority by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states whether a full class may be joined via waitlist, the maximum waitlist position offered, the notice given on promotion from the waitlist, whether a walk-in standby spot may be taken without a prior booking and its fee, and whether the tier's holder receives priority in studio capacity ahead of the general waitlist.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes whether waitlisting is enabled for a full class, the maximum position offered before the waitlist closes to new joiners, and the hours of notice given when a waitlisted member is promoted into an open spot. Each tier separately fixes whether a walk-in standby spot may be taken without a prior booking and, where allowed, the fee for doing so. Each tier also fixes whether its holder is given priority studio-capacity status ahead of the general waitlist, or only standard status.

| Tier | Waitlist enabled | Max waitlist position | Promotion notice (hours) | Walk-in standby allowed | Standby fee (USD) | Capacity priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | Yes | 5 | 4 | Yes | 10.00 | Standard |
| 10-Class Pack | Yes | 5 | 4 | Yes | 10.00 | Standard |
| 20-Class Pack | Yes | 8 | 3 | Yes | 5.00 | Standard |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | Yes | 10 | 2 | No | 0 | Standard |
| Specialty Studio Pack | Yes | 5 | 6 | No | 0 | Priority |
| Founding Class Pass | Yes | 8 | 3 | Yes | 0 | Priority |

## Points of judgement
- Only the Specialty Studio Pack and Founding Class Pass carry priority studio-capacity status; every other tier carries standard status.
- Unlimited Monthly Classes and Specialty Studio Pack are the only tiers that do not permit a walk-in standby spot; Founding Class Pass permits it at no fee, while the other standby-eligible tiers charge a fee.
